title: CLTR Cutover AuthorityState record
description: Phase 136J, Implementation Group 2. Shape-only wire contract for an AuthorityState companion record (CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 v1.0 Sec.18). An AuthorityState document is the companion evidence-adjacent record documenting a resolved-authority claim; the architectural relationship (production authority pointer -> AuthorityState record -> authoritative generation) is documentation only (Sec.7.1 note below) and is never established by schema validity alone (Sec.1, Sec.40). Legacy lifecycle remains the sole production authority; CLTR remains derivative. This is one of the two record families where authority_role "authoritative" is a structurally permitted enum value (Sec.9); is_authoritative nonetheless remains const false unconditionally per the shared authority_disclosure definition -- 136J deliberately does not attempt to express Sec.9's conditional exception in schema form (disclosed limitation NON-BLOCKING-136J-1; see phase documentation). Schema validity of this record never itself resolves, creates, or persists current authority.

schema_id.description: Always present. Identifies this document as validated against the AuthorityState schema.

schema_version.description: Always present. This file's own MAJOR.MINOR version.

contract_version.description: Always present. CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 version this schema was generated against.

record_type.description: Always present. Fixed family tag for this record type.

record_id.description: Always present. Shape-checked only; never recomputed at Layer 2.

record_digest.description: Always present. Digest of this document itself. Shape-checked only; never recomputed at Layer 2.

created_at.description: Always present. Never used to establish record identity or ordering across documents.

transition_id.description: Always present. authority_state is one of the families that requires transition_id (shared/identity.schema.json).

active_authority_epoch.description: Always present. Family-tagged reference to the AuthorityEpoch record this state claims currency for. A valid reference never implies the referenced epoch record actually exists or is itself active (Layer 4/6).

authoritative_generation.description: Conditionally present: required when authority_kind is "cltr". A valid reference never implies the referenced generation is certified, authoritative, or published (Layer 4/6).

publication_evidence_reference.description: Always present. Family-tagged reference to the publication_evidence record supporting this state. publication_evidence.schema.json is not implemented in this phase (Group 5); this field is a shape-only forward reference and does not require the referenced document to already exist for schema validity.

pointer_digest.description: Always present. Digest carried by an authority-pointer-shaped reference. This package defines no authority pointer record and does not resolve or create one; shape-checked only.

verification_state.description: Always present. Record-local VerificationState. "unverified" requires an accompanying uncertainty disclosure; "verified" forbids one (mutually exclusive at the local shape level).

uncertainty.description: Conditionally present: required when verification_state is "unverified", forbidden when verification_state is "verified".

authority_disclosure.description: Always present. authority_role "authoritative" is a structurally permitted value on this record family only (Sec.9), but is_authoritative remains const false unconditionally per the shared definition -- see file description and NON-BLOCKING-136J-1.

epoch_reference.description: A record_reference locally restricted to record_family "authority_epoch".

publication_evidence_reference.description: A record_reference locally restricted to record_family "publication_evidence", preventing a wrong-family reference (e.g. a cutover_request or rollback-evidence reference) from being substituted here.

reason.description: Always present when this object is present. Short, fixed-purpose uncertainty disclosure sentence.

uncertainty.description: Bounded local uncertainty-disclosure object. Present only when verification_state is "unverified".
